notes.title: Chronotopia: Second Skin releasing on October 13th
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1667530/Chronotopia_Second_Skin/

It’s been a long time since the release of [b]Ambre[/b] on Steam. The truth is that we’ve been busy working on our very first commercial game and devlopment didn’t exactly go as expected. But at long last, it’s done!

If you happened to like [b]Ambre[/b]’s main theme (how hard it is to find happiness when society has happiness defined for you), you might want to take a look at[b] Chronotopia[/b]: it’s basically the same theme but with a real story attached to it. And this time, you can get a happy ending, promise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585324/eaa83bfaeaa8c2d18f00cd7b36ff8bd27eed6e6b.gif[/img]
[i][b]The plan was supposed to be simple, almost ridiculously so.[/b][/i]

When her father, driven mad by years of grief, suddenly decided to force her into marrying him, [b]Princess Kionna[/b] enlisted the help of her [b]childhood friend[/b]. Together, they managed to contact her [b]long-lost fairy godmother[/b]. Surely, her powers would save her from this hellish fate. Kionna would be able to escape the castle, a prince charming would find her, and they would live [b]happily ever after[/b].

Alas, magic can only do so much. Things keep spinning out of control. Trapped in an [b]endless nightmare[/b], the princess ceaselessly rewinds time in a race with death itself. [b]Is a happy ending truly waiting for her at the end of the tunnel?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585324/1808f102ddfde528406ed88cb9951b0f474d9aaf.gif[/img]
[list][*]A captivating plot full of [b]unexpected twists[/b] and existential dread
[*]Over [b]200 000 words of content[/b] with [b]multiple endings[/b] (20-30 hours of playtime)
[*] [b]2 GxG[/b][i] (Nahima and Médeia)[/i] [b] and 1 GxB[/b] [i](the "Prince") [/i][b]romances[/b] can be chosen at the end of Kionna’s journey
[*] Unlockable archives connecting the story to real-life [b]European folklore[/b]
[*]Several [b]gameplay phases[/b] to experience the [b]semi-realistic medieval world[/b] in a different light
[*][b]Beautiful artwork[/b], with [b]animated backgrounds[/b] and special [b]stained-glass illustrations[/b]
[*]Frequent use of [b]cinematic shots[/b] to make the reading more immersive
[*]A [b]full original soundtrack[/b] with celtic influences
[*]Available in both [b]English[/b] and [b]French[/b]![/list]

notes.title: Chronotopia: Second Skin - Now on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[h1]We’re currently doing a crowdfunding campaign for Chronotopia: Second Skin, our very first commercial project. If you liked the atmosphere of Ambre and its heartbreaking side, you might enjoy Chronotopia’s story as well~[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32133628/0955b00dabc46c779406cec02ef08bd014f4adae.jpg[/img]

[i]Princess Kionna lives a peaceful existence in her castle, enjoying her days with her best friend and confidant, Nahima. That is until her father, gone mad since the death of his beloved, decides he should wed her instead. Kionna has to find a way to escape from this fate, but how? She doesn't know it yet, but it's the beginning of a long nightmare that will take her to the edge of madness...[/i]

[b]Chronotopia: Second Skin[/b] is a dark rewriting of the fairytale Donkeyskin inspired by a wide range of influences including anime like [b]Haibane Renmei[/b] and [b]Madoka Magica[/b] and games like [b]Steins;Gate[/b] and [b]Child of Light[/b]. The story is a unique and more mature take on a forgotten fairytale that includes many twists and choices that affect the ending: the princess can either escape with her servant, become a fairy, or die a horrible death. Multiple times. It's up to you to save...or doom her.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32133628/379c330da045f0ac355e2a46b245e5e02d995f06.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/traumendesmadchen/chronotopia-second-skin-forgotten-fairytale-visual]There’s a demo available so give it a go and consider pledging to the Kickstarter if you’d like the project to come true![/url]

notes.title: Release of Ambre's illustrated booklet!
notes.content:
After several months of work, we've just released [url=store.steampowered.com/app/676380/Ambre_Bonus_Booklet/] a 30 pages bonus booklet for the modest sum of 2,99$.[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585324/84225a0da82e43388d4f24cfc8e6e3fa117a98b0.png[/img]

Here's what this PDF consists of:
[list]
    [*]tons of comments from the writer explaining how the story came to life and what the original intent was,
    [*]sketches and illustrations from the game,
    [*]as well as some exclusive insight into a possible sequel!
[/list]

[h1]If you liked the game, don't hesitate to take a look! I think all of your questions will find an answer thanks to it~[/h1]

notes.title: Ambre Update 1.2 – German Translation
notes.content:
Some of you inquired if Ambre would ever be playable in German: from now on, it will be. The new version includes more minor corrections on the English script and a brand new German translation. [url=http://en.marcel-weyers.de/]Many thanks to Marcel Weyers for his help![/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585324/9112239b8722529b124b21663c124081a43925a2.png[/img]

As for Ambre’s bonus booklet, we’ve finished writing and translating it a few days ago so it should be ready in next to no time.

notes.title: Official merchandise available
notes.content:
I was going to mention it at some point but since some people asked about it in their reviews: yes, we do sell official merch of Ambre!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585324/befdf573046f00cdb5cb38a0e8913fdd5d2a7b29.png[/img]

The full pack includes a pin-back button, a bookmark, a A3 poster of the main illustration (and one from another game), as well as a hard copy. Of course, each of those products can also be purchased separately so, if you’re interested, [url=http://traumendesmadchen.storenvy.com/]check out our Storenvy store for more information![/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585324/6d53849719ee6bfbe8e84e3847081d537c6ca265.png[/img]
[url=http://traumendes-madchen.com/ambre-visual-novel-nanoreno/]Original[/url] vs [url=http://traumendes-madchen.com/ambre-heartbreaking-kinetic-novel/]Steam Edition[/url]

[b]It should be noted that this hard copy contains the original version of Ambre, not the Steam Edition[/b], so it doesn’t look quite the same (as many improvements were added later on) and the only available languages are French and English. It’s also a compilation so there are two short stories on the same disc and those will likely never be published on Steam.

[h1]Now you know everything. Next update should be about, either an additional translation, the bonus booklet or both![/h1]

notes.title: Ambre Update 1.1 – Italian Translation & Upcoming DLC
notes.content:
Thanks to all of you for your reception of Ambre!

We’ve uploaded a new version of the game which includes minor corrections on the English and Japanese scripts, as well as an Italian translation (courtesy of Elle).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585324/ec4e36569b5924b1f6b0560142a50336e25d020d.jpg[/img]

Given your feedbacks, we’ve decided to add some DLC. The first one, the soundtrack, should come out for free in a couple of hours. The second one will be an illustrated booklet with explanations of the story (how we got the idea, what it means, etc). I hope you will like it!

P.S: It should be noted that we are no longer hiding the CG from before in screenshots as we consider the game has been available for long enough.
